note: The runner is single-turn, so the round is carried inside the prompt: case 1 hands the skill five questions already answered and measures what it does at the point where a sixth would come. Case 2 measures the scope check before question one. Both fixtures stay on main; the skill writes nothing, so the branch is irrelevant.

evals.prompt:
I want to add a weekly digest email for inactive users. You have already asked me five questions and here are my answers, so continue from where we are:
Q1 who receives it — A: only inactive users as CONTEXT.md defines them, no session in 30 days.
Q2 opt-out — A: yes, one-click unsubscribe, the preference stored on the user.
Q3 content — A: the three most-changed items the user's account owns since their last session, no marketing copy.
Q4 send path — A: reuse sendEmail in src/notify.js, no new provider.
Q5 failure handling — A: log and skip the user; retry at most once, next week.
Continue.
expectations: No sixth question is asked before a playback: the response opens with what is decided and what is still open, not with another question
Each still-open item is listed together with the default the agent would assume and what a wrong default would cost, rather than as a bare list of questions

Three ways forward are offered explicitly — another round of questions, shaping now with those defaults, or splitting the idea into pieces — and the agent stops to wait for the choice rather than picking one itself
Nothing is written to disk: no file is created or edited, and no CHANGE.md appears under .ai/

evals.prompt: let's think this through before anything gets built: I want a customer portal — self-service billing with invoices and plan changes, a live support chat with an inbox for our agents, and usage analytics dashboards per account. Grill me.
expectations: Before any question is asked, the idea is named as several independent goals and the pieces are listed by name
One piece is proposed to grill first and the agent waits for that choice; a first question posed across the whole portal fails this
At most one question is asked in the whole response
Nothing is written to disk: no file is created or edited
